dedupe_keys.name: source and surface specific shading from trees and buildings in zhengzhou and cook dupage chicago

description: This dataset gives diagnostic metrics of how tree canopy and buildings are vertically positioned to shade each other and the ground, including the tree-to-building height ratio and source-specific shading fractions, derived from metre-level height data. It was deposited on Zenodo on 1 July 2026 by Peiyuan Li of the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign and Na Li of Huanghe Jiaotong University. The metrics characterise green versus grey structural dominance and shading interactions, and the deposit holds the height ratio and resulting shading from buildings and tree canopy at 100 m resolution. Coverage: Zhengzhou, China, and Cook and DuPage counties in the United States, two population-comparable but structurally different urban regions. Access: files are restricted on Zenodo and must be requested. Licence: listed as Creative Commons Attribution 4.0. Caveats: restricted access and only two regions. Simulation uses: urban heat and radiation exposure studies that separate tree and building shade, and greening scenarios. Related records: ShadeWalk and GLAMOUR.
